armor.name: Shadow Helm
armor.description: Forged in absolute darkness. The shadows themselves protect your head.

armor.name: Shadow Plate
armor.description: Dark armor that seems to absorb light. Near-impenetrable defense.

armor.name: Shadow Grips
armor.description: Gauntlets that shimmer like smoke. Your hands barely exist in this realm.

armor.name: Shadow Legguards
armor.description: Leg armor woven from pure shadow. Moves silently with your steps.

armor.name: Shadow Treads
armor.description: Boots that leave no footprints. Walk between worlds.
